titleEn: The Day We Had a Fight

pages.text: Pongi and the child next door were pulling on the same ball. It was like a tug-of-war.
Pongi let go and went home. "I won't be the first to talk."
Dad brought a sheet of paper. "Then you could draw a picture and give it to your friend."
Dad picked up a pencil. Pongi just watched beside him.
Dad drew quickly. A round face, two dots, a long mouth.
Pongi looked at the paper. It didn't look anything like her friend.
The friend Dad had drawn looked like a duck. But her friend wasn't a duck.
Pongi ran over with the paper. "Dad drew you like this!"
Her friend looked at the picture and laughed, holding their tummy.
Her friend turned the paper over and drew Pongi. Now Pongi was a duck too.
